hook_text: Would you rather have 1/4 or 1/8 of a chocolate slab? Most people pick wrong.
clip_script: One chocolate slab. Cut it into 4 pieces: each is a quarter. Cut the same slab into 8: each is an eighth. 8 is bigger than 4, but the pieces are smaller. More pieces, smaller pieces. Take 1/4. Now same bottom numbers: 5/8 or 3/8? Same-size pieces, so more pieces wins: 5/8. And the egg box: half is 6 of 12 eggs. 5/12 is less than half, 7/12 is more. Count in quarters along the fun run: 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 1 kilometre, 1 and 1/4. Bottom tells the pieces, top tells how many.
visual_style: Two identical slabs being cut into 4 and 8 pieces side by side, then an egg box filling to the halfway line.
mood: Tempting, like choosing the bigger slice.
pacing: The chocolate choice first, then the same-bottom rule, then the egg box half, then the counting run.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and order 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/6 and 1/12 from smallest to biggest.
